subject: Vendor provisioning & PO/Invoice routing (PayBridge)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Reed <natalie.reed@paybridge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor provisioning & PO/Invoice routing (PayBridge)

Hi Natalie —

Thanks for the productive call last week. Per our discussion, attaching Redwood's AP onboarding packet to start vendor provisioning in PayBridge. Can you confirm the exact vendor fields you need in your system so we can make sure submitted invoices are processed without delay? Specifically we need to confirm:

- PO number placement (invoice header vs. invoice line) — we prefer PO on the invoice header and in the invoice filename
- Required tax/VAT evidence for EU entities (we're US-headquartered but have EU billing exceptions)
- Bank ID format you accept (ACH / IBAN / SWIFT)
- Any required supplier ID or vendor code format you will assign

Attached: redwood_ap_onboarding_packet.pdf (contains W-9, payment remit email, and contact details).

If there’s a portal invite flow, send the invite to ap@redwood.inference and billing@redwood.inference; otherwise we’ll upload via the vendor form. Also note: we typically require the PO number to be present on the invoice for automated matching — if PayBridge requires an additional invoice URN/PO reference, tell us the prefix/format and we’ll include it.

Next step from our side: once you confirm required fields I’ll return the filled W-9 and bank mandate.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
[Attachment: redwood_ap_onboarding_packet.pdf (application/pdf, 280KB)]

From: Natalie Reed <natalie.reed@paybridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: PayBridge AP <ap@paybridge.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor provisioning & PO/Invoice routing (PayBridge)

Ben —

Thanks for sending the packet. A couple quick clarifications to complete our vendor setup:

1) We need the vendor's legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the 1099/W-9 and the VAT ID if a EU entity will bill us (you can put "N/A" if not applicable).
2) Bank details: we need SWIFT/BIC + account number for international payments. For US ACH payments we accept ABA routing + account number; please indicate preferred rails per invoice currency.
3) Remittance contact: a single email address for automated remittance advices (ap@redwood.inference suggested).
4) PO requirements: PayBridge requires the customer PO number in a single field (we map to invoice header -> PO_NUMBER) and we can optionally ingest a separate invoice reference (URN) if you provide it. If you can provide a sample invoice filename convention we can validate automated ingestion.

Portal: I'll trigger a vendor portal invite to ap@redwood.inference once we receive the completed W-9 and bank mandate. Expected provisioning time after submission is 2–3 business days.

One more thing: do you require early payment / dynamic discount enrollment? We have that option in the portal but need explicit consent.

Regards,
Natalie Reed
Sr. AP Manager — PayBridge
[Attachment: none]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Reed <natalie.reed@paybridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800

Natalie —

Appreciate the quick reply. Attached are the requested documents: W-9 (w9_filled_20261115.pdf) and the bank mandate (bank_mandate_payments.pdf). Key fields below for your ingestion: 

Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789
VAT ID: N/A (US entity)
Preferred rails: USD invoices — ACH (ABA + acct); EUR invoices — SWIFT (IBAN on request)
Remittance email: ap@redwood.inference (primary); billing@redwood.inference (cc)
Invoice filename convention: RedwoodInvoice_<PO>_<YYYYMMDD>_<invoice#>.pdf (we can produce this format upon request)
PO placement: please map PO_NUMBER to invoice header; if you also ingest an invoice URN we will populate it as Redwood-URN-<invoice#> in a separate field.
Early payment: yes — we'd like to opt into early payment programs, please include enrollment details in the portal invite.

Let me know if you need a notarized copy or additional legal docs — otherwise please send the portal invite when you're ready and confirm the vendor code you assign so we can reference it on invoices.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachments: w9_filled_20261115.pdf (application/pdf, 45KB); bank_mandate_payments.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)]
